title: Provider trade categories — admin-managed catalog, multi-category providers, grouped searchable selector

tasks.title: Create host-trade-category catalog entity schemas
tasks.description:
Create packages/schemas/src/entities/host-trade-category/ following the poi-category files: host-trade-category-group.schema.ts, host-trade-category.schema.ts, *.crud.schema.ts (create; update OMITS slug, D8), *.query.schema.ts, *.http.schema.ts, *.access.schema.ts, host-trade-category-ref.schema.ts (HostTradeCategoryRefSchema = {id, slug, nameI18n, groupSlug}), public-host-trade-catalog.schema.ts (PublicHostTradeCatalogSchema), index.ts, and export from the entities barrel. Fields: slug kebab-case, nameI18n (es required), displayWeight, lifecycleState, keywordsI18n (lowercase, max 30 per locale, max 40 chars each), groupId.
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-3.5.
Tests (packages/schemas/src/entities/host-trade-category/__tests__/*.test.ts): non-kebab slug rejected; nameI18n without es rejected; update schema with slug present -> rejected; keywords >30 entries and >40 chars rejected; PublicHostTradeCatalogSchema parses a nested sample.

subtasks.title: Entity + crud + query + http + access schemas

tasks.title: Update host-trade, alliance-lead and usage-ref schemas to multi-category
tasks.description:
packages/schemas: in entities/host-trade/host-trade.schema.ts replace category with categories: HostTradeCategoryRefSchema[] (reads); in host-trade.crud.schema.ts add categoryIds: uuid[] (1..10, unique) for admin writes; host-trade.query.schema.ts and host-trade.admin-search.schema.ts replace category with categories (comma-separated slug list preprocessed to string[], max 30); host-trade.http.schema.ts follows. entities/alliance-lead/alliance-lead.schema.ts and alliance-lead.crud.schema.ts: category -> categorySlugs: string[] | null, required-for-service_provider becomes non-empty array (line ~39), 1..10 entries, message key moves to zodError.allianceLead.categorySlugs.requiredForServiceProvider (the key itself is added to i18n in the web i18n task). host-trade-usage refs: HostTradeUsageProviderRefSchema.category -> categories: HostTradeCategoryRefSchema[]. Do NOT delete HostTradeCategoryEnum yet (contract release).
ACs: AC-1.5, AC-1.6, AC-4.1, AC-5.4.
Tests (existing __tests__ in packages/schemas/src/entities/host-trade/__tests__/host-trade.schema.test.ts, host-trade.admin-search.schema.test.ts and entities/alliance-lead tests): categoryIds with 0, 1, 10, 11 entries and duplicates; categories query 'a,b' -> ['a','b'], empty string -> [], >30 rejected; alliance-lead service_provider with [] or null rejected, 11 slugs rejected, non-provider with null accepted.

tasks.title: Add HOST_TRADE_CATEGORY_* permissions and re-count frozen guards
tasks.description:
Add HOST_TRADE_CATEGORY_VIEW|CREATE|UPDATE|DELETE|RESTORE to PermissionEnum (packages/schemas/src/enums/permission.enum.ts) with values hostTradeCategory.view|create|update|delete|restore (camelCase like poiCategory.*). Same set gates groups. Adding values trips frozen guards in 3 packages: RE-COUNT each (do not bump by one blindly) and list the guards touched in the PR: packages/schemas/test/enums/permission-naming-convention.guard.test.ts, the permission enum count/inventory tests in packages/schemas, packages/seed/test/role-permission-audit.test.ts and any inventory/mocks in packages/service-core or apps/api (rg for the current permission total to find them).
ACs: AC-3.6.
Tests: permission-naming guard still passes and asserts the 5 new values use the camelCase family convention; enum-count guard equals the freshly counted total.
DONE NOTE: no frozen total-permission count exists; only the HOST_TRADE category count (12 -> 17) in test/enums/host-trade-hos376.permissions.test.ts. Grouped under the existing HOST_TRADE category.

subtasks.title: Re-count and update frozen guards in schemas/seed/service-core
List guards touched for PR body

tasks.title: Create host_trade_category_groups and host_trade_categories dbschemas
tasks.description:
Create packages/db/src/schemas/host-trade/host-trade-category-group.dbschema.ts and host-trade-category.dbschema.ts modelled on packages/db/src/schemas/destination/poi-category.dbschema.ts. Groups: id, slug (text unique), name_i18n jsonb I18nText, translation_meta jsonb default {}, display_weight int default 50, lifecycle_state LifecycleStatusPgEnum default ACTIVE, admin_info, audit cols, deleted_at, deleted_by_id. Categories: same plus group_id uuid NOT NULL FK -> groups.id onDelete restrict, keywords_i18n jsonb default {}. Indexes: unique slug (includes deleted rows), group_id, lifecycle_state. Export from the schemas barrel.
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-3.4 (DB side), D8.
Tests (packages/db/test/schemas/host-trade/host-trade-category-group.dbschema.test.ts and host-trade-category.dbschema.test.ts, pattern of poi-category.dbschema.test.ts): column names/types/defaults, group_id FK onDelete=restrict, unique slug index present, lifecycle_state default ACTIVE.

tasks.title: Create r_host_trade_category join and alter host_trades and alliance_leads dbschemas
tasks.description:
Create packages/db/src/schemas/host-trade/r_host_trade_category.dbschema.ts (host_trade_id FK -> host_trades.id cascade, category_id FK -> host_trade_categories.id RESTRICT, PK (host_trade_id, category_id), index on category_id) modelled on r_poi_category.dbschema.ts without isPrimary; add relations. Edit host_trade.dbschema.ts: category becomes NULLABLE (keep column, indexes hostTrades_category_idx and hostTrades_destinationId_category_idx untouched; expand step, nothing reads/writes it after this release). Edit packages/db/src/schemas/alliance/alliance_lead.dbschema.ts: add category_slugs text[] nullable; keep category varchar.
ACs: AC-3.4, AC-4.2 (DB side).
Tests (packages/db/test/schemas/host-trade/r_host_trade_category.dbschema.test.ts + update host_trade.dbschema.test.ts and an alliance_lead dbschema test): PK composite, FK actions (cascade/restrict), host_trades.category notNull === false, alliance_leads.category_slugs is array nullable.
NOTE (from T-003): permissions are a Postgres enum in the DB (see 0126_cool_captain_flint.sql), so db:generate MUST also emit ALTER TYPE ADD VALUE for the 5 hostTradeCategory.* permissions.

tasks.title: Generate and review structural migration (expand step)
tasks.description:
Run pnpm db:generate to produce the versioned migration in packages/db/src/migrations/ (carril 1): create the 3 tables, add alliance_leads.category_slugs, DROP NOT NULL on host_trades.category. Review the SQL by hand: it MUST NOT drop category, its indexes or the pgEnum (those are release N+1). Commit the migration plus drizzle meta snapshot. Verify the drift guard passes (schema vs migration) and the migration applies on a scratch DB via pnpm db:migrate (never db:fresh-dev inside a worktree).
ACs: AC-3.4 (restrict at DB level).
Tests: drift guard clean; apply the migration on a throwaway DB and assert via psql/information_schema that host_trades.category is nullable, r_host_trade_category FKs have the expected delete rules, and no DROP statements exist in the generated file.

subtasks.title: Apply on scratch DB and run drift guard

tasks.title: Create HostTradeCategoryGroupModel and HostTradeCategoryModel
tasks.description:
Create packages/db/src/models/hostTrade/host-trade-category-group.model.ts and host-trade-category.model.ts extending BaseModel (pattern: packages/db/src/models/destination/poi-category.model.ts). Methods: findPublicCatalog() (join groups+categories, lifecycleState=ACTIVE and deletedAt IS NULL on both levels, ordered by group displayWeight, category displayWeight, name), findActiveBySlugs(slugs), findByIds(ids), countLinkedHostTrades(categoryId) (non-deleted host_trades only), countActiveChildren(groupId). Export from models barrel.
ACs: AC-1.1, AC-3.3, AC-3.4, AC-1.7.
Tests (packages/db/test/integration/host-trade-category.model.integration.test.ts, isDbAvailable pattern): inactive/deleted rows excluded at BOTH levels in findPublicCatalog; ordering by displayWeight then name; countLinkedHostTrades ignores soft-deleted host_trades; findActiveBySlugs ignores unknown slugs.

tasks.title: Add category EXISTS predicate, name ordering and batched hydration to HostTradeModel
tasks.description:
Edit packages/db/src/models/hostTrade/host-trade.model.ts: (1) order the directory by name only (was category ASC at ~line 59); (2) add a model method that adds EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r_host_trade_category r JOIN host_trade_categories c ON c.id = r.category_id WHERE r.host_trade_id = host_trades.id AND c.slug = ANY($1)) for any-of filtering, usable by search, count and admin search (the key-value where map cannot express it); (3) add hydrateCategories(hostTradeIds) returning Map<hostTradeId, CategoryRef[]> with ONE batched query ordered by group displayWeight, category displayWeight, slug.
ACs: AC-5.2, AC-5.3, AC-5.4, AC-4.4.
Tests (extend packages/db/test/integration/host-trade.model.integration.test.ts): any-of with 2 slugs returns a provider with both categories ONCE; unknown slug ignored; all-unknown yields empty; hydration order; spy on the query executor to assert hydrating 20 providers issues a constant number of queries (no N+1); directory order equals name ASC.

tasks.title: Add transactional replaceCategories to HostTradeModel
tasks.description:
In packages/db/src/models/hostTrade/host-trade.model.ts add replaceCategories({hostTradeId, categoryIds, tx}) that deletes the links not in categoryIds and inserts the missing ones inside the caller-provided transaction (delete-missing + insert-new atomic, AC-4.2). Idempotent when the set is unchanged.
ACs: AC-4.2.
Tests (packages/db/test/integration/host-trade.model.integration.test.ts): replacing [a,b] with [b,c] leaves exactly {b,c}; unchanged set is a no-op; forced failure on insert (invalid category id) rolls back and the OLD set remains; deleting a category with links fails on the FK RESTRICT while deleting a host_trade cascades its links.

tasks.title: Rebuild packages after schema changes before running dependant tests
tasks.description:
After merging staging into the worktree and finishing the schema/db changes, rebuild dist of the affected packages so dependants do not see new exports as undefined (risk in spec §12): run corepack pnpm --filter @repo/schemas build, then @repo/db, then @repo/cache-tags (and @repo/i18n if already edited). Use CI=true prefix (no TTY). Verify by typechecking one dependant with CI=true so tsc really runs (apps are not @repo/* names: use correct filter names).
Tests: new exports (HostTradeCategorySchema, HOST_TRADE_CATEGORY_* permissions, new dbschema tables) are importable from a dependant package typecheck with no 'no exported member' errors.

tasks.title: Add CACHE_TAG_HOST_TRADE_CATEGORIES to @repo/cache-tags
tasks.description:
Add the constant CACHE_TAG_HOST_TRADE_CATEGORIES to packages/cache-tags/src (follow the existing tag vocabulary file and its naming), export it, register it in any tag inventory/registry the package keeps.
ACs: AC-3.2, AC-6.1.
Tests (packages/cache-tags/test/*): the tag is exported, is a non-empty string, is unique among tags, and matches the package's naming-format guard.

tasks.title: Create seed baseline JSON for catalog groups and categories
tasks.description:
Add packages/seed/src/data/hostTradeCategoryGroup/*.json (5 groups) and packages/seed/src/data/hostTradeCategory/*.json (29 categories) with DETERMINISTIC ids, content exactly per spec §11 (slug, nameI18n es/en/pt, displayWeight steps of 10, es keywordsI18n, en/pt keywords empty, group slug -> group id). Register the two entities in the seed manifest/required list and the seed JSON-schema (packages/seed/src/schemas or equivalent), plus seedFactory entries following poiCategory (packages/seed/src/data/poiCategory/).
ACs: AC-1.1, AC-1.2 (keywords incl. 'pozo ciego').
Tests (packages/seed/test/): counts are 5 groups and 29 categories; slugs unique and kebab-case; every category group reference resolves; every es nameI18n present; ids are valid uuids and stable across runs; keywords obey max 30 / 40 chars.

tasks.title: Switch hostTrade seed fixtures to categorySlugs and seed join rows
tasks.description:
Edit packages/seed/src/data/hostTrade/*.json: replace category (enum) with categorySlugs: string[] using the backfill map (PILETA_JARDIN fixture -> ['piletas','parque-jardineria']); update the host-trade seed factory/normalizer to resolve slugs to category ids and insert r_host_trade_category rows; update the seed JSON-schema for hostTrade; update alliance-lead seed fixtures if they carry category (-> categorySlugs). Order the seeder after the catalog seeders.
ACs: AC-2.1, AC-5.1.
Tests (packages/seed/test/): every hostTrade fixture has >=1 valid slug present in the catalog baseline; the seeder produces join rows (20 providers, 21 links given PILETA_JARDIN gives 2); no fixture still carries category.

tasks.title: Create seed data-migration step A: upsert catalog groups and categories
tasks.description:
Run pnpm db:seed:make host-trade-category-catalog (carril 3) to create the numbered module in packages/seed/src/data-migrations/. Step A: upsert the 5 groups then 29 categories BY SLUG (same content and the same deterministic ids as the baseline from the baseline JSON; import from the baseline data to stay single-source). Idempotent; never overwrites admin-edited rows beyond what an upsert-by-slug-on-missing implies (insert if missing, do not clobber nameI18n edits on re-run). Satisfies seed dual-write rule together with the baseline task.
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-1.1.
Tests (packages/seed/test/data-migrations/host-trade-category-catalog.test.ts): on empty DB inserts 5 + 29; second run inserts 0 and changes nothing; a pre-renamed nameI18n is preserved on re-run; categories point at the right group.

tasks.title: Add backfill step B to the data-migration with meta.requiresColumns
tasks.description:
In the same data-migration module (steps A and B are ONE migration so order is guaranteed): after the upsert, backfill r_host_trade_category from host_trades.category and alliance_leads.category_slugs from alliance_leads.category using the spec §5.5 map (CERRAJERIA->cerrajeria, PLOMERIA->plomeria, ELECTRICIDAD->electricidad, GAS->gas-instalacion, CLIMATIZACION->climatizacion, LIMPIEZA->limpieza-domicilio, FLETES->fletes, VIDRIERIA->vidrieria, CARPINTERIA->carpinteria, PILETA_JARDIN->piletas AND parque-jardineria, PLAGAS->control-plagas, INTERNET->internet-tv, ALBANILERIA->albanileria). Unknown old value: log and skip, never abort. Insert with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Set meta.requiresColumns: ['host_trades.category','alliance_leads.category'] so the runner aborts loudly if the drop ships in the same release (HOS-433).
ACs: AC-2.3.
Tests (same test file, DB fixture with all 13 old values): expected join rows, PILETA_JARDIN yields 2; leads converted to categorySlugs (PILETA_JARDIN -> both slugs); unknown value 'FOO' skipped with a log and no throw; running twice is idempotent (no duplicates); meta.requiresColumns is exactly the two columns; guard test: runner refuses when the column is missing and the table has rows.

tasks.title: Add permission grants for HOST_TRADE_CATEGORY_* (baseline and data-migration)
tasks.description:
Dual-write: (1) baseline: grant the 5 new permissions to the admin roles in the role-permission seed data (packages/seed/src/data/rolePermission or equivalent, same roles that hold poiCategory.* / hostTrade.*); (2) data-migration step C in the same module as tasks 14/15: insert the same role_permission rows on live envs, idempotent. Update packages/seed/test/role-permission-audit.test.ts expectations (re-counted, not blindly bumped).
ACs: AC-3.6.
Tests: after running the migration SUPER_ADMIN/ADMIN roles have all 5 permissions and non-admin roles none; second run adds 0 rows; the audit test passes with the new total; no permission appears in baseline but not in the migration or vice versa.

tasks.title: Verify seed dual-write guard and run the data-migration locally
tasks.description:
Commit the baseline and the data-migration, then run scripts/check-seed-dual-write.sh against the COMMITTED diff vs staging (it reads committed diff, not the working tree) and confirm it passes with both. On a scratch DB (NEVER pnpm db:fresh-dev inside a worktree) run db:migrate -> db:apply-extras -> db:seed:migrate and confirm: 5 groups, 29 categories, backfilled links, ledger row recorded, second run applies 0.
ACs: AC-2.1, AC-2.3.
Tests: guard exit code 0; SQL counts after migration (select count(*) from host_trade_category_groups = 5, categories = 29); seed_migrations ledger contains the migration once.

tasks.title: Create HostTradeCategoryGroupService with permissions and CATEGORY_IN_USE error
tasks.description:
Create packages/service-core/src/services/host-trade-category/host-trade-category-group.service.ts extending BaseCrudService, plus host-trade-category.permissions.ts mirroring poi-category.permissions.ts (PermissionEnum only, never roles), index exports. Add the business error code CATEGORY_IN_USE to the service error map (FIRST check the map for a colliding name; spec open point) mapped to HTTP 409. Rules: create/update (update schema rejects slug), deactivate always allowed, soft delete blocked with CATEGORY_IN_USE if any non-deleted category exists in the group, restore allowed, deleted slug cannot be reused. Return Result<T>.
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-3.3, AC-3.4, AC-3.5, AC-3.6.
Tests (packages/service-core/test/services/host-trade-category/host-trade-category-group.service.test.ts): without permission -> FORBIDDEN; delete with active child -> CATEGORY_IN_USE; delete empty group ok; restore ok; deactivate with children ok; update with slug rejected; creating with a deleted slug fails.

tasks.title: Create HostTradeCategoryService with in-use delete semantics
tasks.description:
Create packages/service-core/src/services/host-trade-category/host-trade-category.service.ts extending BaseCrudService. Create requires an existing, non-deleted group (group_id), nameI18n.es, kebab slug; update rejects slug; admin list filters groupId, lifecycleState, q (name/keywords via safeIlike, never raw ilike); soft delete returns CATEGORY_IN_USE (409) if any non-deleted host_trades row links it (model.countLinkedHostTrades); deactivate always allowed; restore allowed.
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-3.3, AC-3.4, AC-3.5, AC-3.6.
Tests (.../host-trade-category.service.test.ts): create under missing/deleted group fails; delete with linked live provider -> CATEGORY_IN_USE; delete when only a soft-deleted provider links it succeeds at service level; INACTIVE patch ok even in use; q filter escapes % and _.

tasks.title: Implement getPublicCatalog() in the category services
tasks.description:
Add getPublicCatalog() to packages/service-core/src/services/host-trade-category/ returning PublicHostTradeCatalogSchema shape in one query via HostTradeCategoryModel.findPublicCatalog (no permission, guest allowed). Groups with zero active categories omitted. Output validated with the Zod schema.
ACs: AC-1.1, AC-3.3, AC-6.1.
Tests (.../host-trade-category.public-catalog.test.ts, models mocked per package conventions): inactive category hidden, inactive group hides all its categories, deleted rows hidden, empty groups omitted, order by group weight then category weight then name, output passes PublicHostTradeCatalogSchema.parse.

tasks.title: Update HostTradeService search, count and admin search for the categories filter
tasks.description:
Edit packages/service-core/src/services/hostTrade/host-trade.service.ts (_executeSearch, _executeCount near lines 487/508 and the admin search): stop building where.category; translate the categories: string[] param into the model EXISTS predicate (task 8) so it also applies in count; hydrate categories for every returned page with ONE batched model call (hydrateCategories); drop any use of the removed category field.
ACs: AC-4.4, AC-5.1, AC-5.2, AC-5.4.
Tests (packages/service-core/test/services/hostTrade/host-trade.service.categories.test.ts): categories ['plomeria','pintura'] calls the predicate method and NOT the where map; count uses the same predicate (count equals list length); unknown-only slugs -> empty list; hydration invoked once per page; page items carry categories refs.

tasks.title: Add categoryIds validation and atomic set replacement to HostTradeService create/update
tasks.description:
Edit host-trade.service.ts create/update: with categoryIds validate every id exists and is not deleted; an INACTIVE id is allowed only if already linked to that provider (AC-4.3), otherwise ValidationError naming categoryIds; require 1..10 unique ids; write the row and call replaceCategories in the SAME transaction (use the transaction pattern used elsewhere in this service). Update without categoryIds leaves the set untouched.
ACs: AC-4.1, AC-4.2, AC-4.3.
Tests (.../host-trade.service.categories-write.test.ts): unknown id -> 400-class error; deleted id rejected; inactive new id rejected; inactive already-linked id accepted; 0 and 11 ids rejected; update without categoryIds keeps the set; replaceCategories receives the same tx as the row update; failure inside tx propagates (no partial write).

tasks.title: Update HOST_TRADE_OWNER_FORBIDDEN_FIELDS for categoryIds
tasks.description:
Edit packages/schemas/src/entities/host-trade/host-trade-managed-fields.ts: add categoryIds and remove category from HOST_TRADE_OWNER_FORBIDDEN_FIELDS (D3: providers never edit categories). Update packages/schemas/src/entities/host-trade/__tests__/host-trade-managed-fields.guard.test.ts and host-trade.owner.schema.test.ts. Check host-trade.owner.schema.ts (owner update schema) does not accept categoryIds.
ACs: AC-4.1 (admin-only editing), D3.
Tests: owner update payload containing categoryIds is rejected / stripped per the existing strictness; the guard test lists categoryIds and no longer lists category; owner schema keys do not intersect the forbidden list.

tasks.title: Update alliance-lead provisioning to resolve categorySlugs
tasks.description:
Edit the alliance-lead provisioning (alliance-lead.provisioning.ts in packages/service-core/src/services/alliance-lead/; ~line 90 currently safeParse(lead.category)): resolve lead.categorySlugs to ACTIVE category ids via HostTradeCategoryModel.findActiveBySlugs; keep active ones; if none active return skip: 'no-active-category'; otherwise insert join rows inside the provisioning transaction. Never read lead.category.
ACs: AC-2.1, AC-2.2, AC-2.3.
Tests (service-core test next to the provisioning tests): [plomeria, destapaciones-desagotes] all active -> exactly two join rows; one deactivated -> only the active one; none active -> skip 'no-active-category' and no host_trade row; lead with only legacy category (categorySlugs null) never reads category; join insert runs in the same tx.

tasks.title: Validate lead categorySlugs against the active catalog on create
tasks.description:
In the alliance-lead create path of packages/service-core/src/services/allianceLead/ (service create/_beforeCreate) validate categorySlugs against the active catalog: unknown, inactive or deleted slug -> ValidationError naming field categorySlugs; 1..10 slugs required when type is service_provider; de-duplicate. Anonymous form, so this is the only gate.
ACs: AC-1.5, AC-1.6, AC-1.7.
Tests: stale (inactive) slug -> error with field 'categorySlugs'; empty array for provider -> error; 11 slugs -> error; duplicates collapsed; valid active slugs persisted to category_slugs and legacy category not written.

tasks.title: Hydrate categories in benefit-usage provider refs
tasks.description:
Where HostTradeUsage provider refs are built (host-trade benefit usage service in packages/service-core/src/services/hostTrade/ and the db model packages/db/src/models/hostTrade/host-trade-benefit-usage.model.ts), replace category by categories: HostTradeCategoryRef[] using the batched hydrateCategories (one query per page).
ACs: AC-5.1.
Tests: usage list returns provider.categories in catalog order for a provider with 2 categories; no per-row queries (assert hydrate called once); contract matches HostTradeUsageProviderRefSchema.

tasks.title: Add public GET /api/v1/public/host-trade-categories route with cache tag
tasks.description:
Create apps/api/src/routes/host-trade-category/public/list.ts + index (createSimpleRoute/createOpenApiRoute pattern, ResponseFactory) returning getPublicCatalog(); response emits CACHE_TAG_HOST_TRADE_CATEGORIES via the existing cache-tag header mechanism; register in the public router and OpenAPI.
ACs: AC-1.1, AC-3.2, AC-3.3, AC-6.1.
Tests (apps/api/test/routes/host-trade-category/public-list.test.ts): 200 without auth; inactive and deleted rows (both levels) absent; ordering; response header carries the cache tag; response validates PublicHostTradeCatalogSchema.

tasks.title: Add admin CRUD routes for host-trade-category-groups
tasks.description:
Create apps/api/src/routes/host-trade-category-group/admin/ (list with page+pageSize, getById, create, update (PATCH), delete (DELETE), restore (POST /:id/restore)) using createAdminListRoute/createAdminRoute patterns, permissions HOST_TRADE_CATEGORY_VIEW/CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE/RESTORE, mount at /api/v1/admin/host-trade-category-groups. Error order per apps/api/docs/error-contract.md: 401 -> 403 -> 400 -> 404 -> 409 (permission gate BEFORE row lookup; CATEGORY_IN_USE answers 409, a 4xx is never INTERNAL_ERROR).
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-3.4, AC-3.5, AC-3.6.
Tests (apps/api/test/routes/host-trade-category-group/admin.test.ts): each route 401 without session, 403 without permission, 400 on invalid body and on slug in PATCH, 404 unknown id, 409 CATEGORY_IN_USE with live children, happy paths; pagination uses page/pageSize.

tasks.title: Add admin CRUD routes for host-trade-categories
tasks.description:
Create apps/api/src/routes/host-trade-category/admin/ (list with filters groupId, lifecycleState, q plus page+pageSize; getById; create; PATCH; DELETE; POST /:id/restore) mounted at /api/v1/admin/host-trade-categories; same permissions and error order as the group routes. DELETE answers 409 CATEGORY_IN_USE when a non-deleted host_trade links it.
ACs: AC-3.1, AC-3.3, AC-3.4, AC-3.5, AC-3.6.
Tests (apps/api/test/routes/host-trade-category/admin.test.ts): 401/403/400/404/409 matrix, happy paths, groupId/lifecycleState/q filters, DELETE of an in-use category -> 409 code CATEGORY_IN_USE, PATCH with slug -> 400, INACTIVE patch allowed on in-use.

tasks.title: Purge CACHE_TAG_HOST_TRADE_CATEGORIES on every admin catalog write
tasks.description:
Wire the existing purge fan-out (find it with rg for how other admin writes purge cache tags in apps/api/src, e.g. the cache-purge middleware/helper) so create, update, delete and restore on BOTH group and category admin routes purge CACHE_TAG_HOST_TRADE_CATEGORIES. Reads never purge.
ACs: AC-3.2, AC-3.3.
Tests (apps/api/test/routes/host-trade-category/cache-purge.test.ts): spy on the purge function; each of the 8 write routes (4 per table) triggers exactly one purge with the tag; GET routes do not; a failed write (409/400) does not purge.

tasks.title: Update host-trade protected and admin routes for categories and categoryIds
tasks.description:
Edit the existing host-trade list routes (protected GET /api/v1/protected/host-trades and admin list) so query param categories (comma-separated) is forwarded to the service, and admin create/update accept body categoryIds; remove category handling. Keep the regression intent of apps/api/test (admin.test.ts:246-265) with the param renamed to categories. The base where map can silently drop the filter, so assert rows are EXCLUDED.
ACs: AC-4.1, AC-4.2, AC-4.4, AC-5.4.
Tests (apps/api/test/routes/host-trade/*.test.ts + integration if the suite has DB): categories=plomeria,pintura returns any-of; unknown slug ignored; all-unknown -> 200 with empty list; filter excludes non-matching rows (not just forwarded); admin POST/PATCH with categoryIds 0 or 11 -> 400; owner route with categoryIds rejected.

tasks.title: Update alliance-lead submit and approve routes for categorySlugs

tasks.title: Create pure match-catalog-query search util

Do NOT mark the issue Done while the label exists; the smoke is signed off through /smoke or smoke-tanda.
